name: 27WON Performance

about:
27WON Performance is based in Henderson, Nevada. The company traces its roots to founders who began customizing and racing personal cars before launching a Mazda-focused performance business in 1998. After two decades of experience, they applied that knowledge to the Honda platform, naming the new venture after the Honda RA271 — the first Japanese-built Formula 1 car to enter a race. The brand emerged from a passion for elevating Honda and Acura performance to a new level.

The company designs and manufactures a range of bolt-on performance parts for late-model Hondas and Acuras, including cold-air intakes, big-brake kits, turbocharger upgrades, coolant expansion tanks, inlet pipes, brake calipers, rotors, and bypass valves. Products are developed through engineering and validation processes that emphasize fit, function, and aesthetics. The catalog covers 10th- and 11th-generation Civic Si, Type R, Type S, and Integra models.

27WON serves automotive enthusiasts, track-day drivers, and owners seeking OEM-plus upgrades for Honda and Acura vehicles. Customer ideas drive the product roadmap; nearly every new part originates from community submissions. The company also offers installation services and build documentation through its 'Installations-Builds' section.

The brand's stated differentiator is a 'no-shortcuts' philosophy: each component is crafted to perform and look amazing, with a focus on stopping faster, accelerating harder, and carving corners. Core values — putting the team first, being a utility player, executing the right tasks well, elevating each other with candor, and loving cars and community — frame the culture. The name itself honors Honda's racing heritage, reinforcing a mission to redefine the aftermarket.
